entries.title: Proverbs 15:1
segments: ¶A soft answer turns away wrath, But a harsh word stirs up anger.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:2
segments: ¶The tongue of the wise uses knowledge rightly, But the mouth of fools pours forth foolishness.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:3
segments: ¶The eyes of the LORD [are] in every place, Keeping watch on the evil and the good.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:4
segments: ¶A wholesome tongue [is] a tree of life, But perverseness in it breaks the spirit.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:5
segments: ¶A fool despises his father's instruction, But he who receives correction is prudent.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:6
segments: ¶[In] the house of the righteous [there is] much treasure, But in the revenue of the wicked is trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:7
segments: ¶The lips of the wise disperse knowledge, But the heart of the fool [does] not [do] so.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:8
segments: ¶The sacrifice of the wicked [is] an abomination to the LORD, But the prayer of the upright [is] His delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:9
segments: ¶The way of the wicked [is] an abomination to the LORD, But He loves him who follows righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:10
segments: ¶Harsh discipline [is] for him who forsakes the way, [And] he who hates correction will die.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:11
segments: ¶Hell and Destruction [are] before the LORD; So how much more the hearts of the sons of men.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:12
segments: ¶A scoffer does not love one who corrects him, Nor will he go to the wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:13
segments: ¶A merry heart makes a cheerful countenance, But by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:14
segments: ¶The heart of him who has understanding seeks knowledge, But the mouth of fools feeds on foolishness.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:15
segments: ¶All the days of the afflicted [are] evil, But he who is of a merry heart [has] a continual feast.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:16
segments: ¶Better [is] a little with the fear of the LORD, Than great treasure with trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:17
segments: Better [is] a dinner of herbs where love is, Than a fatted calf with hatred.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:18
segments: ¶A wrathful man stirs up strife, But [he who is] slow to anger allays contention.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:19
segments: ¶The way of the lazy [man is] like a hedge of thorns, But the way of the upright [is] a highway.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:20
segments: ¶A wise son makes a father glad, But a foolish man despises his mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:21
segments: ¶Folly [is] joy [to him who is] destitute of discernment, But a man of understanding walks uprightly.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:22
segments: ¶Without counsel, plans go awry, But in the multitude of counselors they are established.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:23
segments: ¶A man has joy by the answer of his mouth, And a word [spoken] in due season, how good [it is]!

entries.title: Proverbs 15:24
segments: ¶The way of life [winds] upward for the wise, That he may turn away from hell below.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:25
segments: ¶The LORD will destroy the house of the proud, But He will establish the boundary of the widow.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:26
segments: ¶The thoughts of the wicked [are] an abomination to the LORD, But [the words] of the pure [are] pleasant.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:27
segments: ¶He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, But he who hates bribes will live.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:28
segments: ¶The heart of the righteous studies how to answer, But the mouth of the wicked pours forth evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:29
segments: ¶The LORD [is] far from the wicked, But He hears the prayer of the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:30
segments: ¶The light of the eyes rejoices the heart, [And] a good report makes the bones healthy.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:31
segments: ¶The ear that hears the rebukes of life Will abide among the wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:32
segments: ¶He who disdains instruction despises his own soul, But he who heeds rebuke gets understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:33
segments: ¶The fear of the LORD [is] the instruction of wisdom, And before honor [is] humility.
